The basis it feeds agrees. Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.

Ruling: model error; project retained. asset.s179_bad first requires a section 179 election greater than zero; this property's election is zero, so the gate is false whatever its business use. Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.

Ruling: helper of a branch this entry does not take; project retained. The 2025-property route (basis after a 2025 allowance, the half-year and mid-quarter amounts, the 2025 section 179 cost) is figured for property placed in service before 2025 but read by no line it reaches, and the allowance alternatives are figured for property that claims none; the printed lines of the route the entry takes agree (for earlier property, the unadjusted basis, the 2025 rate and line 17). Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.
